Description: Borrower can find a book using its title
Acceptance Criteria: Partial title match returns catalog items and no-match result explains next step

Description: Borrower can find books written by an author
Acceptance Criteria: Author search is case-insensitive and returns all matching items

Description: Borrower can see total and available copies for a title
Acceptance Criteria: Availability is visible before a reservation action

Description: Borrower can request a copy when eligible
Acceptance Criteria: Reservation is confirmed only when a copy is available and account is eligible

Summary: Notify reader when hold is ready
Description: Borrower receives a notice when a reserved item can be collected
Acceptance Criteria: Notice includes item title pickup deadline and collection location

Description: Librarian can review current loans and holds
Acceptance Criteria: Authorized librarian sees loan due date and hold queue counts
